products.title: Inner Radiance Shimmering Eyeshadow Set (3 PC)
products.body_html: This 3PC kit includes all you need to easily enhance your eyes for an enhanced, natural look for everyday. It features two beautiful Eyeshadow 101 shades that apply and blend like a dream, along with a fan-fave mascara for instantly longer lashes.

products.title: 6 PC Eyeshadow 101 Crème-to-Powder Waterproof Eyeshadow Stick
products.body_html:
Choose your favorite 6 pc set! No brush required when using this pigment-packed formula that glides effortlessly across lids before drying to a waterproof powder finish.

how to use: Sweep directly across lids. Blend with fingers or the built-in smudger before the formula sets. For best results, prime the smudger by coating it with color prior to use.

products.title: The Perfect Pair Duo
products.body_html: Define, hydrate, and perfect your pout with this effortless lip duo. Start with the With a Trace Retractable Lip Liner to shape and lock in color, then glide on It’s Balm Lip Crayon for smooth, full-coverage color with a moisturizing, balm-like feel. Together, they deliver long-lasting definition and comfortable, hydrated lips in just a few swipes.

products.title: It’s Balm Moisturizing Lip Color Trios
products.body_html: Creamy, full-coverage lip crayon with a hydrating core that moisturizes and conditions lips. Sunflower butter + vitamin E nourish lips while ultra-fine pigments give bold color and a smooth semi-gloss shine.

products.title: So Plush Glossy Lip Oil (Rosy Glow)
products.body_html: Use this sheer, nourishing formula to help revitalize dry lips while moisturizing with skin-friendly botanical oils.

products.title: Length Matters Mascara
products.body_html:
A buildable, jet black mascara with an extreme lengthening formula that coats lashes from root to tip. The unique, finely tapered micro-bristle brush defines individual lashes and layers for a softly curled, wide-eyed look that stretches the limits.


To use: Start at the base of your lash line, and pull wand upward smoothly without wiggling. Repeat, applying additional coats until you achieve your desired look.
